name: Solomon's Plea to Darkshire
summary: Lakeshire turns to Darkshire as threats close in. Magistrate Solomon asks Lord Ello Ebonlocke to send the Night Watch north and help defend Redridge.

sections.title: A Desperate Call for Aid
sections.body: Blackrock orcs, gnolls, and murlocs attack Lakeshire, while few reinforcements come from Stormwind. Magistrate Solomon sends a formal plea to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire, asking him to send Night Watch militia north into Redridge. With central military support failing across southern Azeroth, human settlements must seek help from one another to survive.

sections.title: Darkshire's Grim Plight
sections.body: Darkshire struggles to hold its borders against undead, ravenous beasts, and the darkness gripping Duskwood. The Night Watch is stretched thin, so the town cannot spare defenders for Redridge when Solomon’s plea arrives.

faq.q: What is Solomon's Plea to Darkshire?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon’s urgent letter to Lord Ello Ebonlocke asks the Night Watch to help defend Redridge against Blackrock orcs and gnolls.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire asking Darkshire for military help instead of Stormwind?
aliases: why does solomon need night watch
faq.answer: Stormwind has sent few garrison troops to its outlying territories amid political inertia and internal strife. Left to face growing attacks alone, Magistrate Solomon seeks help from neighboring human towns.
Lord Ello Ebonlocke is Darkshire’s mayor and chief civic leader in Duskwood. He oversees the town and coordinates the Night Watch, its civilian defense force against the dangers in the woods.

faq.q: Can Darkshire actually spare the Night Watch to help Lakeshire?
faq.answer: No. Duskwood faces undead, feral worgen, and dark magic, and the Night Watch can barely hold Darkshire’s perimeter. It cannot spare fighters to travel to Redridge.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Solomon’s plea shows southern settlements seeking one another’s help while Stormwind gives little support.
As a human traveler, you carry a dispatch that speaks to the danger facing Redridge and Duskwood.
